'''Ivan Varga''' (15 June 1953 – 14 September 2021) was a Slovak politician. He served as a [[Member of parliament|Member]] of the [[National Council of Slovakia]] from 2002 to 2016.

== Biography ==
Ivan Varga was born on 15 June 1953<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2005-04-21 |title=Strana SMER |url=https://www.strana-smer.sk/poslanci/varga.html |access-date=2024-10-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050421145616/https://www.strana-smer.sk/poslanci/varga.html |archive-date=2005-04-21 }}</ref> in [[Hurbanovo]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Aktuality.sk |date=2021-09-15 |title=Zomrel jeden zo zakladajúcich členov strany Smer-SD Ivan Varga |url=https://www.aktuality.sk/clanok/c33lpqt/zomrel-jeden-zo-zakladajucich-clenov-strany-smer-sd-ivan-varga/ |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=Aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref> In 1977 he graduated with a chemical engineering degree from the [[Slovak University of Technology in Bratislava]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Aktuality.sk |title=Ivan Varga - Najnovšie Správy |url=https://www.aktuality.sk/osobnost/ivan-varga/ |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=Aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref> Following graduation, he worked in the Slovak o pharma pharmaceutical compacities, which he priv.<ref name=":0" />

In 1999, Varga was among the founding members of the [[Direction – Social Democracy]].<ref name=":1" /> He served as a Member of the National Council of Slovakia between 2002 and 2016.<ref name=":1" />

== Death ==
Varga died on 14 September 2021 at the age of 68 after a long illness. His death was announced by the Direction party on social media.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Zomrel jeden zo zakladajúcich členov Smeru Ivan Varga - SME |url=https://domov.sme.sk/c/22742844/zomrel-jeden-zo-zakladajucich-clenov-smeru-ivan-varga.html |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=domov.sme.sk |language=sk}}</ref>
